current_implementation: Inspector already calls configureAtlasRenderer, addAtlasLights and createAtlasDrawing(normalize:false). The historical queue gap does not prove the current mini still uses the old renderer recipe.

Inspector borrows source geometry, independently clones materials, clears clone userData, owns its renderer/viewport/derived edges, and never intentionally disposes source geometry or textures. bom3d materialFor resolves dimmed.original then covPrev then source material.

An independent PerspectiveCamera36, recentered visible bounds, sphere/narrower-FOV fit and measured viewport support rotation/reopen. Drag changes its pivot and stops auto-spin; show resets initial orientation and reduced-motion spin.
Existing 放大查看 opens static full SVG in a new window. Mini has drag rotation but no wheel zoom, independent enlargement, fit button or snapshot API.
Dossier 导出当前图册 triggers the main scene export. It is current-main-view SVG with embedded raster plus editable labels/caption/metadata, not a mini export or a1536 master.

hide stops visible rendering; borrowed geometry/texture/environment survive. Clone replacement disposes old cloned materials. Drawing edge cache may persist until component disposal: check bounded reuse/final ownership rather than demand an empty cache after every close.

Desktop/phone light/dark, real mini pixels and full rotated bounds at different aspect ratios; reopen same/different part, whole→part→no-mesh→part and stage0→100. Keep actual viewport/canvas dimensions. Phone detail/whole-mini conservative limits remain explicit.

Real mini drag changes its own pivot and stops auto-spin; main camera/target/stage/selection unchanged. Reopen restores authored orientation and reduced motion. Any new interactive enlargement requires same instance, truthful current geometry/material, own fit/close controls and pointer isolation.
